correctness.rationale: A complete affine-composition proof obtains every exact coefficient and covariance; the strict rearrangement inequality establishes uniqueness for all at least two components and a contraction factor strictly between zero and one; nonconstant centers exclude the zero-variance denominator. Centered-weight expansions, Riemann limits and AR(1) recurrence cover the other statements. Complete up to seven components enumeration and all up to five components pairing checks support but do not replace the proof.

value.rationale: The motivating paired-reversal theory leaves an algorithmically natural choice unanswered: whether reversal is the best fixed order pairing, and when the noise suppression is materially better than factor-two averaging. The theorem gives the exact unique optimizer across all fixed position relabelings and classifies both the stationary noise floor and effective epoch length transition, informing when a second pass may be worth its cost.
